title: draw2d
responsibility: Draw the current player, key and gate state on a native two-dimensional canvas.

inputs.name: draw2d.canvas
inputs.description: Browser canvas that receives the native scene or supplies game-only video frames.

inputs.name: draw2d.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic tick, game state, completed checkpoints, events and execution trace.

inputs.name: draw2d.view
inputs.description: Active game view containing scene direction and executable checkpoints.

inputs.name: create2d.canvas
inputs.description: Browser canvas that receives the native scene or supplies game-only video frames.

outputs.name: draw2d
outputs.description: Paints the supplied game state and view title into the canvas; returns no value.

outputs.name: create2d
outputs.description: Native 2D renderer exposing render and disposal operations for the supplied canvas.
